data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in Australia, I'd put **Stripe, Shopify Payments and PayPal** at the top of the list.

My recommendation depends mainly on what platform your store uses, how much you sell, and whether you sell mostly to Australian or international customers.

Here's how I'd compare them.

## Best payment processors compared

| Provider | Best for | Approx. Australian online fees |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Stripe | Best overall for online stores | 1.65% + \$0.30 |
| Shopify Payments | Shopify stores | 1.75% + \$0.30 |
| Square | Online and physical retail | 2.2% |
| PayPal | Customer familiarity and trust | 2.9% + \$0.30 |
| Airwallex | International sales | 1.65% + \$0.30 |


Indicative published Australian rates; fees depend on card type, plan and transaction circumstances. Sources: [wise.com](https://wise.com/au/blog/best-small-business-payment-gateway-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[croissantbaguette.com.au](https://croissantbaguette.com.au/guides/payment-fees-in-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendations

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe – Best overall**

Great for WooCommerce, custom websites and online businesses. Easy integration, Apple Pay, Google Pay, fraud protection and international payments.

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments – Best for Shopify**

Integrated checkout, straightforward setup and no need for a separate payment gateway. Usually my first choice if you're already using Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal – Best as an additional payment option**

Some customers prefer paying with PayPal rather than entering card details. I'd consider offering it alongside your primary processor.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Airwallex – Best for international sales**

Particularly interesting if you sell overseas, receive multiple currencies or want to manage international business payments.

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

## What I'd recommend for your store

For a typical small Australian online store, I'd start with\:

- Stripe or Shopify Payments as the primary processor.
- PayPal as an additional checkout option.
- Add Airwallex if international sales become significant.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I'd like to find you the most cost-effective option rather than just the most popular one.

**1\. What platform does your online store use?**

**2\. Roughly how much do you expect to process monthly?**

---

**3\. Where are your customers?**

**4\. What's most important?**
